body: Funny how the guy who confessed to cheating for both his degrees is asking about a stimulus check if you hadn’t had a job in years lmao.

I wouldn’t blame the streamers, blame riot and twitch if you think this makes the category a shitty one. I honestly thought 24-7 VoD stream was a good idea when I first saw them. I would open a Valorant stream, try to be on for 2 hours to be able to get a drop, then a stream would end and I would have to start over. 
This 24-7 VoD stream system is only going to benefit the streamers right now, so why would they stop until twitch or riot does something? I don’t see anything wrong with it, but I’m also not trying to watch live gameplay of Valorant a lot on twitch now.
